643-6927-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
643-6927-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Maskwood Nexus, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Damage Control Crew token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

997-2595-4694-7306.easyPrerequisites: Combine Guildmage does not have summoning sickness.
997-2595-4694-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
997-2595-4694-7306.description:
Activate Combine Guildmage's first ability by paying {1}{G} and tapping it, causing each creature you control to enter with an additional +1/+1 counter this turn.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Combine Guildmage.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, scrying 1.
Repeat from step 2.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-792-3249-6723--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-792-3249-6723--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from A Realm Reborn by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Totentanz triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

678-3845-5670--52.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
678-3845-5670--52.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
When the creature dies, Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

728-1981-2415-4268.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
728-1981-2415-4268.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Kor Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

1843-3259-7297.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1843-3259-7297.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Tervigon, triggering Breath of Fury and Tervigon.
Resolve the Tervigon trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

413-2946-4871-6112.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
413-2946-4871-6112.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Fumulus and Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
When the creature token enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cult Conscript enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

215-1129-5434.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Allies.
215-1129-5434.description:
Activate Harabaz Druid by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Harabaz Druid from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Harabaz Druid by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1806-2060-2438-7367-7741.description:
Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability, granted to it by Young Deathclaws, by paying {3} and exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Shang-Chi.
Activate Crystalline Crawler six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Eternal Scourge.
Repeat.

394-997-3240-6462.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Desecrated Tomb triggers, creating a Treasure token and creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3192-5686-6972.easyPrerequisites: The number of red creatures you control excluding Ulasht plus the number of green creatures you control excluding Ulasht is at least X.
3192-5686-6972.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Ulasht.
When Ulasht dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

1482-5660-6701.description:
Activate Jeweled Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it.
Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to its power on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Jeweled Lotus from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Jeweled Lotus ability.
Cast Jeweled Lotus by paying {0}.
Repeat.

5686-7084-7201.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Sapling Nursery triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

176-2921-3000.easyPrerequisites: You control an additional non-Spirit creature.
176-2921-3000.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing a non-Spirit creature
When the creature dies, Requiem Angel triggers, creating two creature tokens due to Chatterfang.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability
Repeat.

679-1423-2894-7123.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
679-1423-2894-7123.description:
Attempt to draw a card. 
The draw will be replaced by Chains of Mephistopheles, instead causing you to discard Golgari Grave-Troll. Then, the draw will be replaced by Golgari Grave-Troll's dredge ability, causing you to mill cards and return Golgari Grave-Troll from your graveyard to your hand.
Dredger's Insight's first ability triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Lich's Mastery triggers, attempting to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

3108-3698-6972--112.description:
If Grim Poppet has any -1/-1 counters on it, activate it by removing a -1/-1 counter from it.
Repeat step 1 as necessary until Grim Poppet has no -1/-1 counters on it.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Grim Poppet.
When Grim Poppet dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Grim Poppet enters, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability from step 3.
Repeat.
Resolve all Grim Poppet abilities, putting infinite -1/-1 counters on any number of creatures.
3108-3698-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost toughness by at least 1 to prevent Grim Poppet from dying due to the -1/-1 counters. You can perform this combo as a lock whenever a creature enters the battlefield to put -1/-1 counters on that creature and cause it to die.

1402-2218-4763-6965.description:
Cast Diamond Lion by paying {2}.
When Diamond Lion enters, Ronin Warclub triggers, attaching itself to Diamond Lion.
Activate Diamond Lion by tapping it, sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any color.
When Diamond Lion dies, Koll triggers, returning Diamond Lion from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

147-6798-6933.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-6798-6933.description:
Cast Incarnation Technique by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Incarnation Technique.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Incarnation Technique, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Incarnation Technique copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2421-3705-4833-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Squee and Skyfire Phoenix, adding {R}{R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {R}{R}.
Skyfire Phoenix triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control that does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent

requires.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and cannot be blcoked and killed by an opponent

3259-6791--95.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and the creature with mobilize as attackers, triggering the creature with mobilize, creating at least one 1/1 Warrior creature token that is tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Warrior token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-6791--95.notes: If you choose a creature with mobilize 2 or higher, this combo makes extra Warrior tokens each loop.

2897-3362.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Gigantoplasm
2897-3362.description:
Cast Gigantoplasm by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Bladewing.
Put Bladewing into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Gigantoplasm's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, returning Bladewing from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Put Bladewing into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Bladewing's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.

2511-2843-6553.easyPrerequisites: Unholy Indenture attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
2511-2843-6553.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Unholy Indenture triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Unholy Indenture from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

1429-3698-5402-5929.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1429-3698-5402-5929.description:
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm and Grinding Station trigger.
Resolve the Captain Storm trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Grinding Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

77-5145-5466-5686.description:
Cast Rakdos Joins Up by paying {3}{B}{R}.
When Rakdos Joins Up enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Faith Healer by sacrificing Rakdos Joins Up.
Resolve the Rakdos Joins Up ability, returning Archon of Falling Stars from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it.
When Archon of Falling Stars enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Archon of Falling Stars.
Resolve the Archon of Falling Stars ability, returning Rakdos Joins Up from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

974-2178-4183.notablePrerequisites:
Saheeli does not have summoning sickness.
There and Back Again has exactly two lore counters on it.
Thornbite Staff attached to Saheeli.
974-2178-4183.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, There and Back Again triggers, putting a lore counter on it.
There and Back Again's third chapter ability triggers, creating a legendary 6/6 Smaug creature token and causing you to sacrifice There and Back Again.
Activate Saheeli by paying {U}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Smaug with haste.
Put either Smaug token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Smaug token dies, it and Saheeli trigger.
Resolve the Smaug trigger, creating fourteen Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Saheeli trigger, untapping it.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {U}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.

81-3457-4235.notablePrerequisites:
Seeker of Skybreak and Kami of Whispered Hopes do not have summoning sickness.
Kami of Whispered Hopes has power 3 or greater.
81-3457-4235.description:
Activate Kami of Whispered Hopes by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting itself.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Seeker of Skybreak's ability, targeting Kami of Whispered Hopes.
Resolve both Seeker of Skybreak abilities, untapping it and Kami of Whispered Hopes.
Repeat.

2092-4449-4949.notablePrerequisites:
Hateflayer does not have summoning sickness.
Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 2 or greater.
2092-4449-4949.description:
Activate Hateflayer by tapping it, adding {R} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Hateflayer by paying {R} and untapping it, dealing damage equal to its power to any target.
Repeat.

565-1283-2450-2719.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Cast Whim of Volrath with buyback by paying {3}, targeting Chromatic Orrery.
Orvar's first ability triggers, creating a token copy of Chromatic Orrery.
Resolve Whim of Volrath, returning it to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead activate the Chromatic Orrery tokens using their second abilities, or target any other permanent.

803-2060-2499-2567-2893.notablePrerequisites:
Fertilid has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
"Plant" chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
803-2060-2499-2567-2893.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Avenger of Zendikar's second ability triggers twice, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

1692-2341-2743-3094.notablePrerequisites:
Helm of the Host attached to Biovisionary.
The Peregrine Dynamo does not have summoning sickness.
1692-2341-2743-3094.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Helm of the Host's trigger.
Activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Helm of the Host's trigger.
Resolve all Helm of the Host triggers, creating three token copies of Biovisionary with haste.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

2557-3209-4214-4871.description:
Cast Sprout Swarm with buyback by paying {4}{G}, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Utopia Mycon twice by sacrificing the Saprolings, adding {1}{G}.
When the Saprolings die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating four Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana, you may forego sacrificing the Saproling tokens.

942-2034-3558-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Crookshank Kobolds, adding {C}{C}.
When Crookshank Kobolds dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, choose not to pay for the trigger.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Samwise the Stouthearted, adding {C}{C}.
When Samwise the Stouthearted dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Samwise the Stouthearted from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Samwise the Stouthearted enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Crookshank Kobolds from your graveyard to your hand, and causing the Ring to tempt you.
Cast Crookshank Kobolds by paying {0}.
Repeat.

1437-1961.notablePrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
1437-1961.description:
Cast Throne of Geth by paying {2}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Throne of Geth spell three times.
Resolve the first and second Throne of Geth spell.
Activate a Throne of Geth by tapping it and sacrificing the other Throne of Geth, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have a large number of Throne of Geth tokens, you may put infinite indestructible counters on Myojin, and use them to infinitely copy any permanent spells you control.

1988-2034-3490.notablePrerequisites:
Blade of the Bloodchief attached to any creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature.
1988-2034-3490.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing any other creature you control, adding {C}{C}.
Blade of the Bloodchief triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature it is attached to.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite +1/+1 counters on the creature with Blade of the Bloodchief attached, you may activate Blade of the Bloodchief's equip ability, attaching it to another creature you control.
If you do, you may repeat step 5 for each creature you control.

2367-3490-4772-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing a creature, adding {R}.
Unruly Mob triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, costing you {1} to create two 1/1 Servo creature tokens.
Repeat.

2050-3547-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Arbor Elf.
Grafted Growth attached to a Forest you control.
2050-3547-4222.description:
Activate Arbor Elf by tapping it, untapping the enchanted forest.
Activate the ability granted to the Forest by Grafted Growth, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Arbor Elf.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite blue mana, you may tap the Forest for other colors instead of blue, adding infinite colored mana.
